The implementation and its bounded validation are complete. The repository report is prepared before the final commit, canonical check and successor delivery. Those later events require their own external receipts. This distinction keeps a useful technical result from making claims about actions that have not happened yet.

The phase adds a finite persistent-homology workbench over GF(2). It follows when connected components and holes appear and disappear as a declared threshold increases. The mathematical method is established; this work supplies a small implementation, explicit examples, failure checks and reusable documentation within the GHC workflow. It does not claim to invent persistent homology or prove a new fundamental law. [Foundational persistence paper](https://research-explorer.ista.ac.at/record/3996).

One hundred contracts are the Cartesian product of twenty operations and five concrete fixtures. This is one hundred bounded operation-case contracts, not one hundred unrelated discoveries. All passed their declared predicates. Their substantive outcomes remain eighty completed finite operations, ten represented records, five open empirical gaps and five exact authority gates. Passing a predicate for a gap does not close that gap.

The core uses exact binary column operations with BigInt bit vectors. A separate oracle enumerates cycles and boundary cosets on the tiny fixtures. It agrees with both interval counts and the core quotient-rank calculation across 419 dimension-and-threshold-pair checks. The unit suite passed forty-seven checks, including malformed inputs, endpoint conventions, a highest-dimensional essential class and explicit counterexamples. Two algorithms written and run by the same owner are stronger than an unchecked single calculation, but they remain same-owner validation rather than independent reproduction.

The boundary of a boundary must be zero. This algebraic identity is checked on every declared column. A failure indicates an implementation or input-closure problem; it cannot be repaired by interpreting the residual as a new physical force. The finite calculation has no spacetime, units, action functional or measurement operator attached to it.

Reported intervals include birth and exclude death. Null death means that no death was seen before the supplied filtration ends. It does not mean a physical quantity lasts forever. Equal birth and death are retained as zero-length pairs in a separate operation and do not contribute to a living homology class at a threshold.
